description: Enables file upload for Image, PDF, Audio, and File blocks in TmNotionEditor. When supplied, drag-and-drop and the Upload tab in the media dialog become active. Without this provider only URL-based media is supported.

methods.name: UploadFileAsync
methods.description: Uploads a file and returns its persistent URL or storage ID. Called when the user drops a file or selects one via the Upload tab.

methods.name: GetFileUrlAsync
methods.description: Resolves a storage file ID to its current public URL. Called when rendering blocks that store a file ID rather than a direct URL.

methods.name: DeleteFileAsync
methods.description: Deletes a file from storage. Called when the user removes a media block.

methods.name: GetFileSizeAsync
methods.description: Returns the file size in bytes. Used to display the size in File blocks.

examples.title: Azure Blob Storage implementation skeleton
